name: vscode-ifc
description: Professional VS Code support for IFC STEP files powered by the IFC Language Server.

commands.title: IFC Language Support: Download Language Server
IFC Language Support: Restart Language Server
IFC Language Support: Show Resolved Language Server

ifc.schema.overwriteExpSchemaWithLocal.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path to a local `.exp` schema file. If set, the language server uses this schema for diagnostics and hover regardless of the IFC file's declared `FILE_SCHEMA(...)`.

ifc.schema.addLocalSchemaToSelection.markdownDescription: Optional list of local `.exp` files or directories containing `.exp` files. These paths are added to the language server's schema selection pool.

ifc.analysis.astFileSizeLimitMb.markdownDescription: Maximum IFC file size in MiB for AST-backed language-server features. Larger files keep basic hover, navigation, and semantic tokens available, but skip schema diagnostics, derived-value hover, and the spatial Outline.

ifc.semanticTokens.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable range-based semantic tokens provided by the IFC language server.

ifc.viewer.includeChildren.markdownDescription: When previewing an element in 3D, also include its decomposition/assembly children (for example a stair's flights or a roof's slabs).

ifc.viewer.includeHostedElements.markdownDescription: When previewing a host in 3D, also include products that fill its openings (for example doors and windows). Openings themselves remain included so host cut-outs render correctly.

ifc.viewer.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show a `Preview in 3D` CodeLens above every element that has geometry (any product with a shape — walls, ducts, furniture, assemblies, …). On large files the lens follows the editor viewport so it stays responsive; it is bounded by `#ifc.viewer.maxFileSizeMb#`.

ifc.viewer.maxFileSizeMb.markdownDescription: Maximum IFC file size (MiB) the 3D preview will index. Only the selected element is rendered, but the file is scanned once to extract it.

ifc.server.path.markdownDescription: Debug/development setting. Absolute path to a custom IFC language server binary. Leave empty for normal use so the extension can use its managed downloaded server. If this path points to a deleted binary, the language server will fail to start; clear the setting to recover.

ifc.server.args.markdownDescription: Debug/development setting. Additional command-line arguments passed to the IFC language server.

ifc.server.versionOverride.markdownDescription: Debug/development setting. Use a specific IFC language server Git tag instead of the version pinned by the extension, for example `v0.3.0`.

ifc.server.githubRepository.markdownDescription: Debug/development setting. GitHub repository used for IFC language server downloads, in owner/repo form.

ifc.server.downloadAssetPattern.markdownDescription: Debug/development setting. Optional substring used to narrow the selected GitHub release asset.

ifc.trace.server.markdownDescription: Debug setting. Trace level for IFC language server protocol traffic.
